description:
The retention and alteration (including limited, selective demolition) of Wallis House in association with the re-instatement of employment use (Class B1-business), the creation of a gallery (Class D1-non residential institutions), the provision of a health club (Class D2-assembly and leisure) and the introduction of residential use (Class C3-dwellinghouses) of the building to form 111 residential units.

(Changes to previously approved scheme 00505/P/P59 - number of studio flats reduces from 29 to 24 (including suite flats), number of one-bedroom flats reduces from 60 to 56, number of two-bedroom flats increases from 15 to 21, and number of three-bedroom flats increases from 7 to 10 and changes to their layouts including terraces; and changes to the layout of the B1 (office), D1 (gallery) and D2 (gym) non-residential floorspace, with the B1 floorspace increasing from 2,598sqm GEA to 2,600sqm GEA, the D1 (gallery) floorspace remaining at 157sqm (GEA) and the D2 (gym) floorspace remaining at 2,038sqm.

In addition, insertion of 4 windows to the south elevation and revisions to the elevations of the building's proposed gallery extension. (PLEASE NOTE AMENDED DESCRIPTION)
